exchanges: ok first coffee of the day, then i become a person
Coffee first, everything else second, a solid plan.
got in early, the tram was empty for once
A quiet ride in is a nice way to start the day.
our office at brightling got a new espresso machine and everyone is feral about it
A good coffee machine can lift the whole office mood.
my cat kropotkin knocked a plant off the shelf at dawn
Cats really do pick the earliest hour for chaos.
my mum's in hospital with pleurisy, shes ok but grumpy
I'm sorry she's unwell, glad she's doing alright.
visiting her after work tonight
I hope the visit cheers her up.
my wife ximena brought me lunch, shes the best
That's a lovely surprise in the middle of the day.
shes cramming for an entomology exam so i dont know how she found the time
Impressive that she managed it with exams looming.
work meeting ran long, so boring
Long meetings are the worst, glad it's over.
my mother in law has gout flaring up too, what a week
Rough timing with both of them under the weather.
wilhelmina from design lent me her portishead vinyl, says theyre the best band ever
Sounds like she has great taste to share.
need to get the renault serviced, its making a whining noise
Probably good to get that looked at before it gets worse.
dad still uses a blackberry and refuses to upgrade
Some people really do stick with what works for them.
honestly kinda jealous of his commitment
There's something admirable about it.
my mate barty is moving to hesperton, leaving the city for good
Big change, the city will miss him.
we had a goodbye drink at corvid, my favourite little cafe
Sounds like a fitting place for a send-off.
feeling a bit sad about it tbh
That's natural, it's hard when a good friend moves.
ok bought a telescope on a whim last night lol
A whim that lets you look at the stars is a pretty good one!
the cat keeps sitting in the box it came in
Cats always seem to love the box more than the thing inside it.
visited mum, she says the food is awful
Hospital food rarely wins any prizes.
might do a big shop at the weekend
Good idea to stock up.
barty's new place has a greenhouse so hes taking up bonsai apparently
That sounds like a peaceful new pastime.
my wife says shell help me set up the scope tonite
Sounds like a fun evening of stargazing.
fingers crossed for clear skies
Hoping the clouds stay away for you!
